title: MRPeasy Review (2026)
intro: MRPeasy is evaluated here as project management & productivity software — MRPeasy is MRP/ERP software for small manufacturers — production planning, inventory, BOMs, purchasing, and shop floor tracking. Per-user pricing (2026-08-19 — confirm on mrpeasy.com/pricing). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose MRPeasy when small-manufacturer MRP is the job.
verdict: Choose MRPeasy when small-manufacturer MRP is the job. Compare monday.com or Hive for non-manufacturing PM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is MRPeasy a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. MRPeasy is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is MRPeasy priced?
faq.answer: Per-user plans from ~$49/user/mo — 15-day trial; confirm on mrpeasy.com/pricing.

faq.question: Does MRPeasy have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 15 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test MRPeasy?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
